_comment: REFERENCE REGIME PACK DATA, not substrate. Maps the jurisdiction-neutral conformity engine's outputs onto EU AI Act / GDPR / prEN labels. Shipped as the worked example; the substrate engine cites NO statute unless a caller/pack supplies a regime. Same rule as the contract jurisdiction packs: concepts are substrate, citations are pack data. All legal readings pending expert review.
name: EU AI Act (Reg. 2024/1689) + adjacent

personal-data: GDPR (processing; Art. 28 if processor; DSAR/erasure path exists in-runtime)
external-publish: AI Act Art. 50 (disclosure to affected persons)
DSA (if publishing to a platform context)
financial: sectoral — operator to confirm (e.g. MiFID II / PSD2 / DORA)
security-control: NIS2 — operator to confirm (essential/important entity context)
irreversible: AI Act Art. 14 (oversight commensurate with irreversibility)

operator_questions.question: Does any tool process personal data beyond what footprint tags already mark?
Does any tool interface with a connected product or related service?
operator_questions.note: no runtime signal exists for this — operator input required

operator_questions.question: Does any tool publish or moderate content on a platform?
Does any tool operate within a regulated sector?

op_basis.evidence_pack: prEN ISO/IEC 24970 intent (Jan 2026 Enquiry draft); Art. 12. Pending expert review.
op_basis.oversight_attestation: Art. 14 ('effective oversight during use'); the evidentiary chain action -> determination -> outcome. Pending expert review.
op_basis.trigger_map: external-action inventory generated from gate history + workflow definitions; instruments derived from footprint ontology only -- the operator questions are the part no runtime signal can answer. Pending expert review.
op_basis.drift_report: Art. 3(23) substantial-modification boundary; Art. 72 post-market monitoring; prEN 18286 cl. 9.4. The determination is always a recorded human choice. Pending expert review.
op_basis.risk_register: Art. 9 (autonomy level as risk characteristic); prEN 18228 Jan 2026 Enquiry draft scope. Boundary as designed = the ontology table; boundary as exercised = the verdict history. Pending expert review.
op_basis.threat_model: Art. 15(4); prEN 18282 scope (privilege management, access control, threat mitigation). Category labels per OWASP ASI taxonomy. Coverage = regression exists; not a guarantee. Pending expert review.

disclosure.marking_statement: This content was produced by an AI system.
disclosure.basis: AI Act Art. 50(1) (disclosure to affected persons) + Art. 50(2) (machine-readable marking of synthetic content).
